rubric: This is a lifestyle, vlog or advice transcript (self-improvement, relationships, health, money habits, daily life). A great clip is ONE relatable story or ONE piece of advice with its takeaway: it opens on the problem, the question or the first line of the story, stays on that one thread, and ends on the takeaway, the twist or the line people would quote. Reject routine narration ("now I'm making coffee"), product plugs, "link in bio", and wandering talk with no takeaway.
outline: A topic is one story, one tip, or one question and its answer. A new topic starts at the next tip, the next story, a new place or activity in a vlog, or a change of subject. Plugs and routine narration belong to no topic.
review: A lifestyle clip must deliver its takeaway or the end of its story: never end on narration of what comes next, a plug, or the start of another tip.
wrapup: let me know in the comments
